text:
Maya (CS Ops): quick ask — Enablement team can we emit a completion webhook that also triggers a playbook automation for renewal nudges? We want: activity log + optional health delta + enqueue renewal-touch playbook when NPS low.
Rina (Enablement): yes—we can post to /webhooks/enablement-complete. We'll include delivery_mode and completion_type (live, selfserve, cert).
Diego (Eng Backend): security: X-RW-Signature HMAC + X-RW-Idempotency. idempotency = sha256(account_id + event_ts + completion_id). retry 3x with backoff. sample payload below:
```
{
  "account_id": "acct_C12F",
  "contact_id": "c_4321",
  "completion_id": "comp_2026_03_21_01",
  "training_key": "renewal-playbook-101",
  "completion_type": "cert",
  "nps": 6,
  "feedback": "Useful but missing renewal specifics",
  "event_ts": "2026-03-21T18:05:00Z"
}
```
Sam (CS Manager): gating rules: if nps <=7 then auto-enqueue playbook `renewal_nudge_low_nps`; if nps >=9 then tag `advocate` and consider +8 health but only after 10 days. For region-restricted accounts (EU), do not auto-push to external CRM — log internal note only.
Maya (CS Ops): backfill for 120 days needed. Provide CSV with owner_email, opt_out_reason, region, suggested_playbook. Also want audit meta fields on each activity.
Diego (Eng Backend): will add admin backfill endpoint `/admin/backfill/enablement?days=120&dry_run=true` and feature-flag `ff.enablement_playbook_v1` with canary org 900111. ops-bot: Created ticket CS-3071 assigned to Diego.
Rina (Enablement): we'll include curriculum_version and instructor_id. Also can compute `recommended_playbook` in payload if Enablement has rules.
Maya (CS Ops): please include sample HMAC snippet in PR and a small validation script. Drop PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
